description:
A maritime logistics analyst needs to separate countries stored as MultiPolygon features into individual landmass polygons for independent analysis. 

1. Open QGIS (it should be running). 
2. Add the vector layer '/home/ga/GIS_Data/ne_110m_countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp' to the project. 
3. Use the 'Multipart to Singleparts' geoprocessing tool to explode the countries into individual polygons. 
4. Export the result as a GeoJSON file to '/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/countries_singlepart.geojson'. 

The output file must be a valid GeoJSON FeatureCollection, contain significantly more features than the input, consist of Polygon geometries (not MultiPolygon), and preserve original attributes.
